title: core: units.py + movement.py
criteria:
Implement realm/core/units.py (all functions of BUILD.md 6.5) and realm/core/movement.py (6.6) with exactly the specified names and signatures. Pure functions only (no DB, no clock). Behaviour:
- unit_cost(unit, tribe, cfg) -> Res: cfg.units[unit].cost scaled by cfg.tribes[tribe].modifiers.unit_cost_mult, each resource floored (math.floor).
- train_time_s(unit, building_level, speed, cfg): train_time_s * training_building_factor ** (max(1, building_level) - 1) / speed, minimum 1.0.
- unit_speed(unit, tribe, cfg): unit speed; multiplied by cav_speed_mult only for units of type 'cav'.
- army_speed(units, tribe, cfg): the minimum unit_speed over units whose count > 0; raise ValueError when no unit has count > 0.
- carry_capacity(units, tribe, cfg): sum(carry*count) * carry_mult.
- troop_upkeep(units, cfg): sum(upkeep*count).
- unit_defense(unit, tribe, cfg) -> (def_inf, def_cav): both multiplied by inf_defense_mult ONLY for units of type 'inf'.
- missing_unit_requirements(unit, levels, cfg) -> list[str]: for each entry of cfg.units[unit].requires whose level in `levels` (default 0) is lower, the Thai message f'ต้องมี {name_th ของอาคาร} เลเวล {n}' (same wording as realm.core.construction.missing_requirements).
- validate_mission_units(mission, units, cfg) -> list[str] of Thai error messages (empty list = valid). Ignore entries with count <= 0. Rules (BUILD.md 5.3): mission RETURN is always valid; no units at all -> ['ไม่มีหน่วยทหาร']; SCOUT mission must contain only units of type 'scout' else 'ภารกิจสอดแนมต้องส่งหน่วยสอดแนมเท่านั้น'; units of type 'scout' on any other mission -> 'หน่วยสอดแนมไปได้เฉพาะภารกิจสอดแนม'; SETTLE mission must contain only the unit 'settler' and exactly cfg.culture.settlers_needed of them (else 'ผู้บุกเบิกไปได้เฉพาะภารกิจตั้งหมู่บ้านใหม่' when a settler is on another mission; 'ภารกิจตั้งหมู่บ้านใหม่ส่งได้เฉพาะผู้บุกเบิก' when a non-settler is in a SETTLE mission; f'ต้องใช้ผู้บุกเบิก {n} คนพอดี' when the settler count is wrong); unit 'chief' only on ATTACK or REINFORCE else 'ผู้นำไปได้เฉพาะภารกิจโจมตีหรือส่งทัพเสริม'. Unknown unit key -> ValueError.
- army_value(units, cfg): sum(cfg.units[u].cost.total() * count).
- movement.wrap(v, size): maps any integer onto -(size//2)..size//2 (for size 101: 51 -> -50, -51 -> 50); distance(x1, y1, x2, y2, size) torus Euclidean; travel_time_s(units, tribe, dist, speed, cfg) = dist / army_speed * 3600 / speed, minimum 1.0.
Tests (hand-computed literals from realm/config/*.yaml, never computed by the functions under test): ironwild spearman cost (56, 40, 24, 40), stonehold spearman cost (70, 50, 30, 50); train_time_s('spearman', 3, 1) == 486.0 and speed 10 -> 48.6, minimum 1; unit_speed light_cavalry windriders 16.8 vs stonehold 14, spearman 7 for every tribe; army_speed {'spearman': 10, 'light_cavalry': 5} == 7 and ValueError for {} and {'spearman': 0}; carry_capacity ironwild {'spearman':10,'light_cavalry':5} == (10*40+5*80)*1.25 == 1000; troop_upkeep {'spearman':10,'light_cavalry':5} == 20; unit_defense spearman stonehold == (40.25, 57.5) and ironwild == (35, 50), light_cavalry stonehold unchanged (20, 10); missing_unit_requirements('swordsman', {'barracks': 1}, cfg) -> two Thai messages (barracks 3, smithy 1) in YAML order ['ต้องมี ค่ายทหาร เลเวล 3', 'ต้องมี โรงตีเหล็ก เลเวล 1']; validate_mission_units for every rule above (valid and invalid cases); army_value {'spearman': 10} == 2000; wrap/distance: distance(-50, 0, 50, 0, 101) == 1, distance(0,0,3,4,101) == 5, wrap(51,101) == -50, wrap(-51,101) == 50, wrap(7,101) == 7; travel_time_s({'light_cavalry': 1}, 'stonehold', 7, 1, cfg) == 1800, same with 'windriders' == 1500, speed 10 -> 180.0 and 150.0, mixed army {'light_cavalry':1,'spearman':1} dist 7 -> 7/7*3600 == 3600, minimum 1 second for dist 0.
notes:
- Thai strings: copy EXACTLY the strings given in the criteria above, letter by letter (they were checked); do not retype or modify them; do not add other Thai text.
- Mission enum: from realm.core.types import Mission, Units, Res.
- cfg is realm.core.config.GameConfig; unit defs are cfg.units[key] with fields type, attack, def_inf, def_cav, speed, carry, upkeep, cost (ResAmount with .wood .stone .iron .food), train_time_s, trained_in, requires.
- A helper to convert ResAmount to Res is fine: Res(c.wood, c.stone, c.iron, c.food).
- Public functions get a one-line docstring and full type hints.
